verdict.rationale: Salv documents a CSV data upload endpoint for bulk-loading historical persons and transactions. Its clearance rules automatically close every alert that meets set conditions, which acts as rule-driven bulk resolution. Beyond these two, there is no documented general bulk-action capability. Missing for 10: bulk update or status-change endpoints for many alerts or persons at once, bulk actions in the UI, documented batch limits or behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Upload historical persons and transactions data using CSV data upload endpoint.
Clearance rules close alerts that meet conditions you set, from the library or your own, and every auto-closed alert stays on the record as an audit trail.
